<js>var html=String(result);if(html==null){html=''}if(html.length<500){try{html=String(java.ajax(baseUrl))}catch(e){html=''}}var base=String(baseUrl);var origin=base.substring(0,base.indexOf('/',base.indexOf('//')+3));var re=/<dd><a href="([^"]+)">([\s\S]*?)<\/a><\/dd>/g;var m,arr=[];while((m=re.exec(html))!==null){var nm=m[2].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(!nm){continue}var u=m[1].charAt(0)=='/'?origin+m[1]:m[1];var q=nm.match(/第([\d]+)章/);arr.push({n:q?parseInt(q[1],10):0,nm:nm,u:u,k:arr.length})}arr.sort(function(a,b){if(a.n&&b.n&&a.n!=b.n){return a.n-b.n}return a.k-b.k});var out=[];for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){out.push({name:arr[i].nm,url:arr[i].u})}JSON.stringify(out)</js>
